title: hieracium jurassicum subsp. lobeliifolium
intro: Hieracium jurassicum subsp. lobeliifolium, commonly known as Alpine Hawkweed, is a rare and endangered plant species found in high-altitude regions of the European Alps. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that can help protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Hawkweed are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins that exhibit antimicrobial, antiviral, and anti-cancer properties. However, further research is needed to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
